reasons.clean: No issues found. Please confirm the extracted fields below are correct before filing.
reasons.fileMissing: File missing — delete or re-upload this document.

reasons.amountsNotInText: the extracted amounts weren't found anywhere in the document's text — please double-check these against the image before confirming
reasons.descriptionSignalsProblem: the description suggests this document may not have been read correctly — please check it
reasons.couldNotReadDocument: We couldn't read this file. Try a clearer photo or a different file.
